subject: general
question: Shri Bhagwant Mann became the Chief Minister of which state in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shri Bhagwant Mann** became the** Chief Minister of Punjab** in **March 2022.**
 
• Bhagwant Mann is a Member of Parliament from **Sangrur, Punjab,** and he is also the **President** of the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) Punjab unit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Delhi **already has a Chief Minister -** Arvind Kejriwal**, who is also the national convener of the AAP.
 
• **Himachal Pradesh** also has a Chief Minister - **Jairam Thakur,** who is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• **Haryana **also has a Chief Minister - **Manohar Lal Khattar,** who is a member of the BJP.
